page.overview:
Who is Kiyoshi?

Kiyoshi is a young man in his early teens, with slightly longer black hair than Shoichi's. He has hazel brown eyes like his siblings and wears a persimmon colored haori over his green kimono.

Kiyoshi is a brave young boy who, despite his very understandable fear, managed to survive on his own in a house with three demons all trying to devour him. He is intelligent and crafty enough to use Kyogai's tsuzumi against him in order to survive. Tanjiro Kamado was impressed by Kiyoshi's will that allowed him to hold out for so long under these conditions.

Due to to his rare blood, the young teen Kiyoshi was targeted as a marechi by demons and taken by force to Tsuzumi Mansion. There, three demons fought over who was going to eat him and the ensuing fight caused Kyogai to lose one of his tsuzumi drums. Kiyoshi took the drum and used it to transport himself away from the demons.

Kiyoshi strikes the tsuzumi whenever danger is near and holds out until help finally arrives. His younger sister Teruko appears to save him alongside a Demon Slayer named Tanjiro. Tanjiro dresses Kiyoshi's wounds and asks for an update on the situation.
